---
title: "🎓 Final challenge: prove your setup works"
---

::: {.mission-meta}
⏱️ About 5 minutes · do this in RStudio, using your Mission 1 project
:::

One last script. If every line here runs the way it's described, your setup — and you — are R Ready.

In `R/analysis.R`, clear out anything left over from earlier missions and run this, one line at a time:

```r
# 1. Confirm R knows where home is
getwd()
```

Check the output against your project's folder name. If it's wrong, stop here and revisit [Mission 1](01-projects.qmd) — everything below depends on this being right.

```r
# 2. Load a real dataset with a relative path — no library() needed
participants <- read.csv("data/participants.csv")
```

If this errors, it's almost always a [Mission 2](02-paths.qmd) problem — check [Help → R cannot find my file](../help/file-not-found.qmd).

```r
# 3. Compute one real summary
mean(participants$score)
```

You should get a single number back — the average score across all participants.

```r
# 4. Break it, on purpose, one more time
oops <- read.csv("data/participants_backup.csv")
```

This should fail to find the file — wrong on purpose: `participants_backup.csv` isn't a file you actually have. Read the message, confirm it's the same shape of error you saw in [Mission 4](04-errors.qmd), then move on (no need to fix this one, it was only ever meant to fail).

## You're R Ready if...

- [ ] `getwd()` pointed at your project folder.
- [ ] `participants` loaded with no red errors.
- [ ] You got a real number back from `mean(participants$score)`.
- [ ] Step 4's deliberate mistake didn't rattle you — you read it, understood why, and moved on.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Nothing left to install, configure, or memorize
